notes: Each test is a sequence of /chat calls. {run} is a unique run id so tests never share memory; {slot}/{slot2} are random future visit slots inside business hours so repeated runs never clash; values captured from a reply with 'capture' can be reused as {name}. The category's first word maps to the grading rubric. See scripts/run_benchmark.py for every check type. Non-chat checks (HTTP errors, rate limit, admin isolation, concurrency) live in scripts/api_tests.py.
